boy.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone square 1:1 RPG comment avatar, 1024x1024, for an unidentified speaking NPC ("Fremde Stimme"). This is a single image, not a sheet or collage.
Style preset adapted only in aspect ratio and anonymous-face requirement: Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Clear anime lineart and clean cel-shading; simple anime textures for cloth, timber, stone and background. No photorealism, no realistic textures, no painterly rendering. Humans have normal rounded human ears, never pointed elf ears.
Composition and shared series art direction: a centered, waist-up human figure dominates the foreground with both freely gesturing hands fully in frame; head comfortably below the top edge. The human, INCLUDING face, exposed skin and hands, is a near-black charcoal silhouette with only minimal flat dark-slate edge accents. No eyes, nose, mouth, facial planes or recognizable facial features whatsoever. The silhouette should be an anonymous living person speaking and gesturing, not a ghost, monster, statue or hooded assassin.
Background is a quiet uncomplicated medieval village in daylight: two or three softly muted cream timber-and-plaster cottages with brown roofs beside a pale village lane, soft blue-gray sky, no crowds, no signs or text. Crisp flat anime drawing throughout; backdrop lighter and lower contrast than the figure. Same calm warm-neutral daylight and charcoal / cream / muted earth-color palette across all five portraits.
Keep the silhouette and expressive hands exceptionally legible at 48px thumbnail size. Arms and hands are separated enough from the torso to read the conversational gesture. No weapons, props, jewelry, emblems, speech bubbles, letters, text, watermark, frame, border or decorative overlay. Opaque full-square scene; no transparency.
Subject variant: one human boy about ten years old; childlike head-to-shoulder proportions, short slightly tousled hair, simple long-sleeve medieval tunic. One open hand raised in a friendly explanatory gesture and the other open near his waist. Convey boy by silhouette shape only, no facial details.
